items.raw_excerpt: Australian cyclist Sarah Gigante has only recently returned to racing after more than 400 days, following complications from a fractured femur. Now the 25-year-old is set to make up for lost time, starting at the UCI World Championships in Montréal.
items.summary_en: Australian cyclist Sarah Gigante is racing again after more than 400 days away with a broken thigh bone. Now 25, she will make her return at the UCI world cycling championships in Montreal, Canada.
items.summary_ko: 호주 자전거 선수 사라 지간테가 허벅지뼈를 다쳐 400일 넘게 쉬었다가 경주로 돌아왔다. 이제 25살이 된 그는 캐나다 몽트리유에서 열리는 세계 자전거 선수권 대회를 시작으로 다시 뛴다.
items.title_en: Cyclist Sarah Gigante is back after a year of injury
items.title_ko: 1년간의 부상 뒤, 자전거 선수 사라 지간테가 돌아왔다

items.raw_excerpt: U2 have played a surprise gig from the balcony of Bewley's on Dublin's Grafton Street as the band marked 50 years together.
items.summary_en: U2 played a surprise show from the balcony of the Bewley's cafe on Grafton Street in Dublin. Thousands of people packed the street to watch and sing. The concert marked50 years of the band together.

items.raw_excerpt: Iniciativa do Grupo +Pet aposta em modelo verticalizado para integrar atendimento clínico, exames e internação na capital paranaense.
items.summary_en: Curitiba, Brazil, opened a new animal health network with a hospital and affordable plans. The project is by the +Pet Group and brings vet visits, exams and hospital stays together in one place.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 쿠리티바에 동물 병원과 저렴한 진료 플랜을 갖춘 반려동물 의료 네트워크가 문을 열었다. 이 프로젝트는 +Pet 그룹이 추진하며 진료와 검사, 입원까지 한 곳에서 제공한다.

items.raw_excerpt: El atacante argentino extendió su estadía en la precordillera por tres temporadas.
items.summary_en: Universidad Católica, a football club in Santiago, Chile, has extended the contract of Argentine forward Justo Giani until 2029. Giani will now stay at the Santiago club for three more seasons.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 산티아고의 축구 클럽 카톨릭대학교가 아르헨티나 출신 공격수 저스토 야니와의 계약을 2029년까지 연장했다. 야니는 앞으로 세 시즌을 더 이 클럽에서 뛰게 된다.

items.raw_excerpt: With Fremantle just one win away from premiership glory, we take a look back at the trajectory of the Dockers, a club originally formed to 'dilute the Eagles'.
items.summary_en: Fremantle is one win away from its first premiership title in the Australian Football League. The club was first formed to weaken the local Eagles team. This is a look at how the Dockers grew into a top side.
items.summary_ko: 프레넬트 도커스는 호주 축구 리그 결승까지 한 판 남긴 상황이다. 처음에는 동네 이글스를 약화시키기 위해 만들어진 팀이었다. 도커스가 어떻게 리그 최강 팀으로 성장했는지 살펴본다.
items.title_en: How the Fremantle Dockers Went From Underdogs to Top Team

items.raw_excerpt: A pre-Hispanic Maya bee house has shed light on how households from roughly 500 to 800 years ago may have produced honey.
items.summary_en: A pre-Hispanic Maya bee house was found near Tulum, Mexico. Researchers say it shows how Maya families made honey about 500 to 800 years ago. The find points to a beekeeping tradition that local people still keep today.

items.title_en: Old Maya bee house found near Tulum, Mexico
items.title_ko: 멕 personallyME ALSO UNKNOWN
items.title_original: Maya apiary found near Tulum reveals roots of beekeeping traditions still practiced today

items.summary_en: Students at SPPU in Pune paused their protest for now. The university vice-chancellor gave them a written promise. The final decision on the mess fee hike will be made on September 26.

items.raw_excerpt: Tennis Auckland says a roof of its centre court used for the ASB Classic will be completed by July next year.
items.summary_en: Tennis Auckland says the roof over its centre court will be completed by July next year. Work on the roof started more than twenty years ago but has not been finished.

items.raw_excerpt: His parents see their stall’s best-known dish as a way of giving back, leaving second-generation owner Adam Danish to make the numbers work. CNA’s Money Mind finds out what the family must do.
items.summary_en: A hawker family in Yishun is working hard to keep their nasi lemak priced at S$2 despite rent of S$10,000. They want to continue serving affordable food to their community.

items.raw_excerpt: Irish band U2 returned to school Friday to put on a surprise class in rock and roll where they formed a half century ago. The band ripped through a seven-song set including an encore of “With or Without You” for hundreds of students in the schoolyard of Mount Temple Comprehensive…
items.summary_en: Irish rock band U2 played a surprise show at Mount Temple Comprehensive School. The band was formed there 50 years ago. About 300 students watched from the schoolyard as the band played seven songs.

items.title_en: U2 Returns to the School Where the Band Began

items.raw_excerpt: For Bangkok residents who want a pet but cannot keep one in their condominium, Dino Gogo offers an imaginative alternative: walking and playing with adoptable dinosaur figures in the park. What began as a small activity among friends has grown into a popular social gathering for people seeking companionship, creativity and a chance to reconnect with their childhood selves. The volunteer-led group limits participation to keep events manageable, combining dinosaur walks with conversation, light ex
items.summary_en: In Bangkok, people who cannot keep a pet in their condo can walk and play with dinosaur toys in a park. The volunteer group started with a few friends and now has many regular members. They join the walks to meet others and have fun.

items.raw_excerpt: Übernachten wie die Inuit – mit dem Komfort eines Hotelzimmers: das bietet das Iglu-Dorf in Gstaad. Jedes Jahr entsteht hier in unzähligen Arbeitsstunden ein Hotelkomplex aus Eis und Schnee. Besucher*innen dieser aussergewöhnlichen Hotelanlage können sich zudem auf ein Käsefondue zum Nachtessen, Entspannung in der Sauna und dem dazugehörigen Whirlpool sowie einen nächtlichen Schneespaziergang freuen.
items.summary_en: In Gstaad, Switzerland, workers build a hotel made of ice and snow every year. Guests sleep in igloo rooms, eat cheese fondue, relax in a sauna and a hot tub, and take a night walk in the snow.

items.raw_excerpt: After 30 days at sea, Digby Campbell was down to his last can of beer and two Red Bulls when three strangers saved the 75-year-old sailor adrift off Darwin Harbour.
items.summary_en: After 30 days at sea near Darwin Harbour, 75-year-old sailor Digby Campbell was nearly out of food and had only one can of beer and two Red Bulls left. Three strangers saw his distress call and came to help. He is safe now and will receive lifesaving awards.

items.title_en: Sailor, 75, rescued at sea with one beer left

items.summary_en: Bracebridge, a small town in Ontario, Canada, is called the waterfall capital of Muskoka. It has many waterfalls, colourful hiking trails, and cute shops. It is a popular fall getaway near Toronto.

items.summary_en: Mamma Mia Focaccia, a small deli on Amoy Street, has closed. The shop said rising costs made it impossible to stay open. Its secret champagne bar, The Champagnery, has also shut down.

items.summary_en: A four-metre tall sculpture of Australian children's author Andy Griffiths is on display at the National Portrait Gallery. It was made with a 3D printer. The art shows his playful young mind inside a grown-up body.

items.raw_excerpt: Ahmedabad’s reimagined dining scene blends zero-proof sophistication, massive design-driven venues, and niche cuisines, redefining its culinary identity
items.summary_en: Ahmedabad is remaking its food scene. The city now has alcohol-free fine dining, huge design-driven venues, and unfamiliar world cuisines. Local diners say the old food identity is being replaced by something new.
